name: Root API Health Check
what: Checks if the root endpoint responds with system health and version metadata.
why: Guarantees that the backend gateway is alive, accepting incoming traffic, and initialized.
details: Platform: Internal Environment Management Platform (IEMP), Version: 1.1.0

name: OpenAPI Specification Availability

why: Ensures employee-facing web portal is compiled, running, and accessible in the browser.

name: Zoho OAuth 2.0 Login URL Generation

why: Confirms proper Zoho client_id, state tokens, redirect URI, and scopes are enforced.

name: Zoho SSO Callback & Token Exchange

why: Validates that successful authentication issues a bearer token and emits an AUTH_LOGIN audit event.

name: Authenticated Identity Profile Retrieval (/me)
what: Queries /api/v1/auth/me to retrieve current user metadata and permissions.
why: Ensures user identity is resolved for permission checks and UI personalization.

name: Role Persona Impersonation Switcher

why: Allows seamless testing of RBAC view boundaries and restricted developer access.
details: Successfully switched to Developer / Tester persona.

name: SSO Logout & Audit Emission
what: Calls /api/v1/auth/logout to terminate session and trigger audit logging.
why: Confirms clean session destruction and security event tracking for compliance.
details: Successfully logged out of Zoho SSO session

name: Environment Inventory Listing
what: Fetches all registered cloud testing environments via GET /api/v1/environments.
why: Ensures platform inventory accurately returns EC2 instances, regions, and owner teams.

name: Single Environment Detail Query
what: Retrieves detailed metadata for environment ID 1.
why: Verifies EC2 instance ID, AWS region, instance type, and associated app URLs.

name: EC2 Start Operation & Lock Acquisition
what: Requests start for environment 'Payment Gateway Staging' (1).
why: Validates state transition to running, app readiness check, and audit trail record.

name: Conflict Prevention on Redundant Start
what: Dispatches a duplicate start request while the instance is already running.
why: Guarantees idempotency and prevents duplicate AWS start API invocations.
details: Correctly rejected with HTTP 400: Instance is already in running state.

name: Decoupled Application Health Probe
what: Executes synthetic HTTP health probe against application endpoint.
why: Ensures application readiness is measured independently of AWS EC2 hypervisor state.

name: EC2 Safe Stop (EBS Volume Preserved)
what: Requests safe stop for environment 'Payment Gateway Staging'.
why: Ensures instance is powered down to eliminate compute charges without deleting EBS disks.

name: Environment Registration (AWS ID Validation)

why: Guarantees that unauthorized or malformed instance IDs are rejected by the backend.

name: EC2 Lifecycle Operation History Query
what: Fetches past START and STOP operation audit records for environment #1.
why: Ensures complete traceability of who initiated each power transition and when.

name: Active Application Tile Inventory Listing

why: Confirms tool launcher presents Core Services, Simulators, Observability, and APIs.

name: Dynamic Tool Tile Provisioning

why: Verifies admins can configure tools dynamically and assign categories.

name: Synthetic Application Health Check Probe

why: Ensures portal surfaces application degradation or offline status before engineers launch.

name: Tool Launch Action Logging
what: Dispatches launch event for tool #8.
why: Ensures tool usage is tracked and recorded in the append-only audit trail.

name: Application Tile Soft-Delete Deactivation
what: Deactivates testing application tile #8.
why: Guarantees that retired tools are safely archived without corrupting foreign keys.

name: Presentation Query & Category Filtering
what: Filters presentations by category='Technical Presentations'.
why: Verifies engineers can browse architecture decks and specifications by topic.

name: Presentation Metadata & Slide Count Verification

why: Ensures complete catalog metadata is preserved for preview modals and storage planning.

name: Authorized Download & Audit Logging

why: Validates that both cloud providers are aggregated accurately into a single FinOps metric.

name: MoM Variance & Month-End Forecast Calculations
what: Checks mathematical accuracy of MoM % change and daily run-rate month-end projections.
why: Ensures financial metrics clearly label projections as forecasts rather than invoiced actuals.

name: Daily Spend Multi-Cloud Trend Breakdown
what: Fetches daily historical spend comparing AWS vs GCP over 30 days.
why: Verifies frontend stacked area/bar charts receive continuous time-series data.

name: Top Service Spend Attribution

why: Identifies highest-cost infrastructure components and percentage allocations.

name: Multi-Cloud Billing Records CSV Export
what: Invokes /api/v1/costs/export to download complete normalized billing records in CSV format.
why: Ensures finance and FinOps teams can export raw data for internal accounting spreadsheets.

name: Append-Only Audit Trail Query
what: Retrieves chronological security and operational audit records via GET /api/v1/audit.
why: Guarantees that actions performed by all employees are immutably logged with timestamps.

name: Audit Trail Action Filtering (ENV_START)
what: Filters audit log specifically for action='ENV_START' operations.
why: Verifies administrators can filter audit logs by specific security or operational event types.

name: Audit Record Tamper Immutability (Delete Denial)
what: Attempts an unauthorized DELETE request on audit event #1.
why: Proves the audit trail is strictly append-only by rejecting deletion requests (HTTP 405/404).
details: Delete rejected with HTTP 404 as expected.

name: Compliance Audit Trail CSV Export
what: Invokes /api/v1/audit/export to export compliance logs for external auditors.
why: Validates compliance requirements for SOC 2 and ISO 27001 data exportability.

name: Employee Directory & Zoho Identity Query
what: Retrieves registered employees with Zoho Subject IDs and assigned roles.
why: Confirms administrators have full visibility over company accounts and permission tiers.

name: Dynamic Role Elevation & Demotion (RBAC)
what: Modifies employee role assignment dynamically via PUT /api/v1/admin/users/3/role.
why: Validates that role updates apply immediately to protected APIs without server restarts.

name: New Employee Access Approval Workflow
what: Approves staged Zoho SSO user account via POST /api/v1/admin/users/3/approve.
why: Fulfills PRD Section 2.8 requirement for administrator-controlled access approval.
details: User dev.tester@company.com approved for platform access.

name: Non-Existent Environment Query Handling
what: Queries environment ID 99999 which does not exist.
why: Verifies API cleanly returns HTTP 404 Not Found without leaking unhandled stack traces.
details: Correctly returned HTTP 404: Environment not found

name: EC2 Instance Format Enforcement Verification
what: Tests safety enforcement on invalid EC2 instance ID strings.
why: Ensures AWS Boto3 adapter strictly enforces 'i-' prefix to block malformed or dangerous commands.

name: Redundant Stop on Stopped Instance Rejection
what: Sends an EC2 stop command to an already stopped environment.
why: Confirms system rejects invalid state transitions with a descriptive HTTP 400 error.
details: Correctly rejected with HTTP 400: Instance is already in stopped state.

name: Invalid Role Switching Rejection
what: Attempts switching active persona to an unsupported role string.
why: Ensures unauthorized roles cannot be injected into authentication context.
details: Correctly rejected with HTTP 400: Invalid role. Choose from: ['super_admin', 'env_admin', 'developer_tester', 'finops', 'content_manager', 'viewer']
